start.speaker: Monologue
start.text: 03:14 AM. Fell asleep on the keyboard again. The rain still hasn't let up.

node_pc_1.text: {a:doubt,tilt}A week of office deadlines, then patching AURA every night. {a:faint_smile,nod}Forgot lunch yesterday, too.

choices.text: Get up and walk it off.

obj_window.speaker: Monologue
obj_window.text: Rain whites out the alley. The corner shop closed long ago.

obj_window_open.speaker: Monologue
obj_window_open.text: Cold wind and rain in my face. {a:faint_smile,laugh}Wide awake now.

obj_mirror.speaker: Mirror
obj_mirror.text: {a:faint_smile,laugh}With these dark circles I could play a panda. Textbook coder in crunch season.

obj_mirror_touch.speaker: Monologue
obj_mirror_touch.text: {a:faint_smile,nod}A few more days. Once the release ships, I'm sleeping for a week.

obj_phone.speaker: Phone
obj_phone.text:
Phone's at 9%. Three unread:
> [21:47] Mom
> [23:15] Mien • 2 messages

obj_phone_mien.speaker: Message • Mien
obj_phone_mien.text:
[23:15] Mien: "Get to bed early. Pick me up tomorrow to celebrate <3"
[23:16] Mien: "It's pouring. Is your room cold?"
{a:faint_smile,laugh}No. The PC case runs like a heater.

node_pills.speaker: Monologue
node_pills.text:
Sleeping pills. "Take 1 before bed."
{a:exhausted,sigh}Can't sleep without them. {a:faint_smile}Mien's rule: after a pill, no driving.

choices.text: Take a few more to be sure.

node_pills_swallow.speaker: Monologue
node_pills_swallow.text: {a:exhausted,sigh}Bitter. The headache eases; my eyelids get heavy.

node_pills_aftermath.speaker: Monologue
node_pills_aftermath.text: {a:doubt,tilt}Not yet. I have to remember our anniversary and open that album first.

node_pills_overdose.speaker: System
node_pills_overdose.text: A few more. The room tilts, turns deep red, then goes black.
node_pills_overdose.glitchText: CRITICAL WARNING: DRUG LEVELS BEYOND TOLERANCE. VITAL SIGNS FALLING TO 0.

bad_ending_0.speaker: Medical Equipment
bad_ending_0.text:
[CRITICAL ALERT]: 03:14 AM. One long beep.
"The patient's stopped breathing... Resuscitate, now!"

[ BAD ENDING 0: SINKING INTO ENDLESS SLEEP ]
bad_ending_0.glitchText: SIRENS ECHOING... HEART STOPPED AT 03:14 AM...

node_terminal_unlocked.speaker: Computer Screen
node_terminal_unlocked.text:
> [PASSWORD ACCEPTED: 1705]
> [UNLOCKED: MEMORY_ALBUM // AN YEN WHARF]
{a:faint_smile,nod}Mien smiling in the afternoon sun at An Yen wharf. 17/05... how could I forget.

choices.text: Take a pill and go to sleep.

node_album_more.speaker: Computer Screen
node_album_more.text: Two milk coffees, Mien's straw chewed flat again. {a:faint_smile,nod}Every afternoon I'd pedal her round the wharf, nice and slow.

choices.text: Take a pill and go to sleep.

obj_tea_table.speaker: Low Tea Table
obj_tea_table.text: A cold bowl of instant noodles. {a:exhausted,sigh}Fourth time this week. Mom would kill me.

node_door_knock.speaker: Monologue
node_door_knock.text: The knocking has stopped. The hallway is pitch dark. {a:doubt,tilt}Wrong door, probably.

node_chapter_1_transition.speaker: Monologue
node_chapter_1_transition.text: Lights off. The rain keeps falling. {a:exhausted,sigh}Handover tomorrow... then take Mien out to celebrate...

ch2_start.speaker: Monologue
ch2_start.text: {a:smile}An Yen wharf. A violet evening, the river lapping. {a:doubt}Exactly as I remember. Strangely exact.

ch2_meet_mien.speaker: Mien
ch2_meet_mien.text: You're awake? {m:playful,hop}Isn't it pretty! {m:gentle}At twenty-two you promised to bring me here every week. Today we kept it.

ch2_mien_accept.speaker: Mien
ch2_mien_accept.text: {m:gentle,nod}No deadlines here. Go for a walk, I'll wait.

ch2_mien_doubt.speaker: Mien
ch2_mien_doubt.text:
{m:worried}Fake? Don't be silly. {m:playful,laugh}You've been up too late again.
She laughs. A little too fast.

obj_ch2_river.speaker: Monologue
obj_ch2_river.text: Clear water, no bottom. {a:doubt}That leaf just drifted past... and past the same spot again.

choices.text: Dip a hand in the water.

obj_ch2_river_touch.speaker: Monologue
obj_ch2_river_touch.text: {a:doubt}Not cold, not warm. A faint tingle, like touching a screen.

obj_ch2_pigeon.speaker: Monologue
obj_ch2_pigeon.text: Two pigeons, eyes wide open. {a:doubt}The wind is tugging my hair. Their feathers don't move.

obj_ch2_pigeon_touch.speaker: Monologue
obj_ch2_pigeon_touch.text: {a:doubt}Hard and smooth, like plastic. No warmth.

obj_ch2_coffee.speaker: Monologue
obj_ch2_coffee.text: Milk coffee, light on sugar, just how I like it. {a:doubt}Still steaming. But the glass is ice-cold.

obj_ch2_bench.speaker: Polaroid on the Stone Bench
obj_ch2_bench.text: {a:doubt}Where I sat in the photo... nothing. Mien's hand rests open, as if holding someone's.

obj_ch2_music_box.speaker: Wooden Music Box
obj_ch2_music_box.text: It stumbles at the end of the phrase. The last two notes loop, like a scratched record. {a:doubt}Then the lid pops open.

obj_ch2_bicycle.speaker: Memory: The Old Bicycle
obj_ch2_bicycle.text: The moss-green Thống Nhất. {a:faint_smile}Mien used to lean her head on my back up the bridge.

obj_ch2_umbrella.speaker: The Umbrella & the Radio
obj_ch2_umbrella.text:
Mien's umbrella is soaking wet, though it hasn't rained all afternoon.
A flash of the eaves by the bridge, a key with a chipped-ear cat charm jingling in someone's hand. The radio crackles: "...collision on the overpass, slippery roads..."
obj_ch2_umbrella.glitchText: RAIN. BRAKES. MIEN CALLING YOUR NAME.

choices.text: Clutch your head: 'The overpass... what happened that night?'

ch2_mien_final.speaker: Mien
ch2_mien_final.text:
{m:turn}{m:worried}'You've noticed all of it, haven't you?'
{m:melancholy,sigh}'I built this place too fast... cold coffee, birds that can't fly.'
{m:crying}{a:sad,sink}'But there's no rainy night here, An. Stay with me.'
ch2_mien_final.glitchText: I JUST NEED YOU TO STAY.

choices.text: "It's beautiful, Mien. But it isn't real. I need to know what happened."

ch2_ending_stay.speaker: Mien
ch2_ending_stay.text:
{m:gentle}'Thank you.'
{m:fading}{a:scared,flinch}Her fingers dissolve into light.
{m:melancholy}'Too late... {m:fading,laugh}{a:sad}you've remembered.'

ch2_truth_confront.speaker: Mien
ch2_truth_confront.text:
{m:gentle}'Same as ever. Back then I lied that I could ride a motorbike just fine, and you saw through it right away.'
{m:melancholy}'If you know now, then... {m:crying}that's that.'
{a:scared}The horizon cracks.

node_hallway_door_312.speaker: Room #312
node_hallway_door_312.text: A PC fan whining, a keyboard clattering. {a:faint_smile,nod}Next door's on a deadline too.

node_hallway_312_knock.speaker: Monologue
node_hallway_312_knock.text: The typing stops for a beat... then carries on. {a:exhausted,sigh}Headphones, probably.

node_hallway_door_316.speaker: Room #316
node_hallway_door_316.text:
[VACANT • FOR RENT]
{a:faint_smile}Mien lived here back in uni. Every evening she'd drag me out for sweet soup.

node_hallway_notice_board.speaker: Residents' Notice Board
node_hallway_notice_board.text:
Power bill: room 314 — 96 units, room 312 — 1,840 units, underlined in red. A water-stained clipping: "...collision on the overpass..."
{a:doubt,tilt}What's 312 running?

node_hallway_window.speaker: Hallway Window
node_hallway_window.text: Rain lashes the glass. Down in the alley, a delivery rider is still working.

node_hallway_stairs.speaker: Stairwell
node_hallway_stairs.text: The iron gate at the bottom is locked. {a:exhausted,sigh}Mrs. Tu locks it at 11.

ch3_start.speaker: Monologue
ch3_start.text: A cold floor. Room 314... but the walls are tearing open, red light pouring in. Sirens outside.
ch3_start.glitchText: [CRITICAL WARNING]: THE DREAM HAS SHATTERED. THE REALITY OF THE EMERGENCY ROOM IS FLOODING IN.

ch3_wake_up.text: That's not the PC fan. It's a ventilator. {a:panic}Disinfectant. What is happening?!
ch3_wake_up.glitchText: THE LINE BETWEEN MEMORY AND REALITY IS BEING TORN APART...

choices.text: Press a hand to your chest.

ch3_heartbeat.speaker: Monologue
ch3_heartbeat.text:
Your heart beats... then stalls.
'V-fib! Charge to 200 joules!'
The wall in front of you splits, white light blazing through.
ch3_heartbeat.glitchText: [CARDIAC ALERT]: HR 38 BPM... CRITICAL VENTRICULAR FIBRILLATION.

obj_ch3_bed.speaker: Emergency Bed
obj_ch3_bed.text:
My mattress is an ER bed, dried blood on the pillow.
[TRUNG HOA HOSP. • ICU • TRAN HOANG AN • 17/05]
obj_ch3_bed.glitchText: [MEDICAL FLASHBACK]: YOU'RE LYING ON AN EMERGENCY BED... NOT IN YOUR ROOM.

choices.text: 'How long... have I been lying here?'

obj_ch3_chart.speaker: Emergency Medical Chart
obj_ch3_chart.text:
An aluminium clipboard at the head of the bed, red stamp 'TRUNG HOA HOSP.':
[TRAN HOANG AN • AGE 24 • ADMITTED 00:52 AM 17/05]
[DEEP COMA — GLASGOW 3/15]
[MECHANISM OF INJURY: ████████ MOTORBIKE — LINE ERASED]
[INJURY SITE: BACK – POSTERIOR CHEST, BLUNT IMPACT]
Clipped behind it, Mien's smudged note: 'Doctor, please save him...'
obj_ch3_chart.glitchText: [CHART 17/05]: DEEP COMA... HOW LONG HAS IT BEEN SINCE THAT NIGHT?

choices.text: 'Glasgow 3... was I really that close to dying?'

obj_ch3_mirror.speaker: Broken Mirror
obj_ch3_mirror.text:
The person in the mirror isn't wearing a hoodie. Bandaged forehead, a tube in the nose.
Those lips move: 'An... wake up...'
obj_ch3_mirror.glitchText: [REAL IMAGE]: THIS IS WHAT YOU TRULY LOOK LIKE NOW.

obj_ch3_bag.speaker: The Soaked Backpack
obj_ch3_bag.text:
My raincoat, cut open from the collar down, the back shredded as if scraped along steel. My keyring's all there... except the bike key.
{s:chime}At the bottom, a ring box: [AN & MIEN • AN YEN WHARF]. I meant to propose at 00:00 on 17/05. The storm came first.
obj_ch3_bag.glitchText: {s:chime}[FATED KEEPSAKE]: THE WEDDING RING THAT NEVER REACHED MIEN'S HAND.

obj_ch3_monitor.speaker: Heart Monitor & 200J Defibrillator
obj_ch3_monitor.text:
The heart monitor: [HR: 38 BPM]. Then the line breaks into a jagged mess.
'V-fib! Shock at 200 joules! CLEAR!'
A jolt tears through your chest.
obj_ch3_monitor.glitchText: [CARDIAC ALERT]: YOUR HEART IS STOPPING IN THE EMERGENCY ROOM.

obj_ch3_window.speaker: Shattered Window • 115 Lights
obj_ch3_window.text: Below the window is a soaked overpass, skid marks on the road. Mien screaming for help.
obj_ch3_window.glitchText: [ACCIDENT FLASHBACK]: THE 115 AMBULANCE SIREN ON THE STORMY NIGHT OF 17/05.

choices.text: 'That night... the rain was so heavy...'

obj_ch3_door.speaker: Sealed Door #314
obj_ch3_door.glitchText: THE DOOR IS SEALED. OUTSIDE ARE THE CHAOTIC FOOTSTEPS OF THE EMERGENCY ROOM.

obj_ch3_pc.speaker: CRT Monitor
obj_ch3_pc.text:
The CRT glows red:
> [WARNING]: HOSPITAL DATA FROM THE NIGHT OF 17/05 IS RESTORING ITSELF.
> [MIEN'S NOTES • ER HALLWAY]: 'They won't let me in. Is his heart beating again?...'
> [SECRET FOLDER]: C:/MEMORY_DUMP/SECTOR_1705 • LOCKED • LOCKED BY: [HIDDEN]

ch3_mien_bleed.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_bleed.text:
{a:sad}'In the Sunset you didn't have to see any of this.' {m:crying}'I hid it so carefully.'
{m:melancholy}'...Are you cold?'
{a:doubt}'...No.' Why is my voice shaking?

ch3_confront_coma.speaker: Mien
ch3_confront_coma.text:
{m:crying,sob}'Wake up...' {m:crying}{a:faint_smile}'Yeah. We'll meet out there.'
{m:melancholy,turn}{a:doubt}She won't look me in the eye.

ch3_confront_truth.speaker: Mien
ch3_confront_truth.text:
{m:crying}'I just wanted you to think you couldn't sleep...'
{m:melancholy}'It isn't in your head. It's in that machine. I locked it away.'
{m:worried,turn}'Once it's open, it won't close again, An.'
ch3_confront_truth.glitchText: THE SECRET IS IN THE MACHINE.

ch3_crack_server.speaker: System
ch3_crack_server.text:
{s:click}Click. The fan goes silent.
[UNLOCKED: C:/MEMORY_DUMP/SECTOR_1705]
Sirens off. Lights off. Just my breathing.

ch4_start.speaker: CRT Monitor
ch4_start.text:
A pale blue cursor blinks. Three files:
> [1] EMERGENCY RECORD, NIGHT OF 17/05
> [2] MIEN'S SECRET DIARY
> [3] SERVER SHUTDOWN NOTICE, TODAY
ch4_start.glitchText: READ IT, AN... THESE ARE THE LAST LINES OF MEMORY ABOUT YOUR EXISTENCE.

choices.text: Open the files in order, starting with [1].

ch4_log1.speaker: Medical Record: Trung Hoa General Hospital
ch4_log1.text:
> [EMERGENCY & ICU - TRUNG HOA HOSPITAL]
> Patient: Tran Hoang An, 24. Admitted 00:52 AM 17/05, about 20 minutes after the accident.
> Diagnosis: motorbike skid on an overpass. Crushed chest, severe brain injury, cardiac arrest before arrival.
> Defibrillated 3 times, pulse back at 01:40. Second arrest at 03:05, 9 minutes of CPR, no response.
> Blood: the sedative diazepam, therapeutic dose.
> Driver's breath-alcohol slip, forwarded by traffic police: negative. Signed: Ng. T. Mien.
> Scene report: the passenger was found wrapped over the driver, back pressed against the median rail.
> TIME OF DEATH: 03:14 AM 17/05.
> Accompanied by: Nguyen Thi Mien, girlfriend, soft-tissue injuries.
ch4_log1.glitchText: [THE ULTIMATE TRUTH]: YOU'RE NOT IN A COMA... YOU DIED 6 MONTHS AGO!

ch4_log2.speaker: Secret Diary: Nguyen Thi Mien
ch4_log2.text:
> [20/05 — Your funeral]
> 'They said your heart stopped at 03:14. I can't accept that.'
> 'Your machine still had 211 AURA brainwave sessions. I rented room 312 next door and loaded you into AURA-NODE-314. Your memory stops on the morning of 16/05.'
> 'The records got loaded too. I locked them in C:/Memory_Dump/ and built the Sunset Town over them.'
> [12/06]
> 'I put on the electrodes and stepped into your room. Every night, at 03:14 exactly.'
> 'Some nights it sounds like you're knocking on 312. I don't dare open it.'
> 'There's something I've never dared tell you, not even in here.'
ch4_log2.glitchText: YOU'RE NOT A LIVING PERSON... YOU'RE A MEMORY COPY THAT MIEN KEPT.

ch4_log3.speaker: Power Cut Notice: Room 312
ch4_log3.text:
> [LANDLADY'S NOTICE • DOOR OF ROOM 312]
> 'Mien, for six months 312 has run machines all night and the breaker keeps tripping. Tonight the fuse box was smoking. I've called the electrician.'
> [POWER CUT]: ROOM 312 BREAKER OFF FOR GOOD AT 03:30 AM.
> The AURA-NODE-314 drive has failed; the sync session lives only in RAM. Cut the power and it's gone forever.
> REAL TIME: 03:27:45. REMAINING: [02 MIN 15 SEC].
ch4_log3.glitchText: [TIME'S UP]: THE SERVER IS ABOUT TO LOSE POWER FOREVER.

ch4_video_call.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_video_call.text:
{a:sad,sink}Mien sits alone in room 312, electrodes still on her temples.
'An... you've read it all, haven't you? {m:pleading,lean}I'm sorry! {m:crying,sob}I can't bear losing you again!'
ch4_video_call.glitchText: WHAT DO I DO, AN... I'M SO SCARED...

choices.text: "Mien... six months keeping watch over me. You've been through so much."
"Why won't you let me go? You deserve to go on living..."

ch4_call_gentle.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_call_gentle.text: {m:crying}'It wasn't hard... I'm just scared that once it's off, I'll never hear your voice again...'

ch4_call_grief.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_call_grief.text: {m:pleading}'Live on how?... Without you, out here is just a graveyard...'

ch4_climax_choice.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ch4_climax_choice.text:
The cursor blinks. Outside room 312, Mrs. Tu's calls grow sharper; the breaker box rattles open.
Mien looks at you through the screen. She is still waiting for an answer.

choices.text: [SHUT DOWN THE SERVER YOURSELF] • 'I'm not cold.'
[SHUT DOWN THE SERVER YOURSELF] • 'I'm not cold.'
[BEG TO STAY TOGETHER] • 'Will you come in here with me?'
[BEG TO STAY TOGETHER] • 'Will you come in here with me?'
[ERASE EVERY SESSION WITH HER] • Erase every memory of Mien, so she has no reason to come back.
[LET GO] • Stand still and wait for them to pull the breaker.

ending_shutdown_1.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_shutdown_1.text:
{a:faint_smile}'Mien... six months. Have you slept a single night?'
{a:sad}'I'm the one who took the pill. I'm the one who insisted on going.' {a:faint_smile}'It wasn't your fault.'
'I couldn't answer you that night. So let me answer now: I'm not cold.'
{a:determined,step}'I shielded you so you could go on living.'

ending_shutdown_2.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ending_shutdown_2.text: {m:sob}Mien buries her face in the keyboard: 'Once it's off... where will I ever hear your voice...'

ending_shutdown_2b.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_shutdown_2b.text: {a:faint_smile,nod}'In the milk coffee at our café. In the old bicycle. {m:melancholy}I'm not in this machine, Mien. This is just the place you haven't dared to leave.'

ending_shutdown_3.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_shutdown_3.text:
{m:nod}'One more thing. Visit my mom this Saturday. {a:sad}Tell her I miss her. She isn't angry with you... she's just afraid you won't come home either.'
{m:crying,laugh}{a:smile}'Okay. I promise.'
{a:determined,step}> [SHUTDOWN]: GOODBYE, AN.

end_game_true.speaker: System
end_game_true.text:
[TRUE ENDING: A REAL DAWN]
The screen goes dark.
Mien opens the door of 312, bows her head to Mrs. Tu, then waits by the window at the end of the hall for sunrise. The storm of 17/05 has finally passed.

ending_corrupt_1.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_corrupt_1.text: {a:panic,tremble}'I'm scared. I don't want to be switched off.' {m:surprised,flinch}'Will you come in here with me? {a:faint_smile}At the river. Just the two of us.'

ending_corrupt_2.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ending_corrupt_2.text:
{m:gentle,nod}Mien nods, as if she's waited six months for this.
{m:melancholy,sigh}Cabinet against the door. Electrodes back on. The sync slider pushed to 'never use'.
'I'm coming.'

ending_corrupt_3.speaker: System
ending_corrupt_3.text:
Out there, the breaker drops at 03:30. In here, those two minutes never end.
The bench at An Yen. The sun stands still. The music box loops back at the eighth bar.
Every few minutes, Mien asks: 'Are you cold?'
You still answer: 'No.'

end_game_bad.speaker: System
end_game_bad.text:
[BAD ENDING: SWEET HELL]
The sunset at An Yen never ends.
In room 312, they find a girl slumped over the keyboard, electrodes still on her temples.

ending_segfault_1.speaker: Monologue
ending_segfault_1.text:
The clock hits [00:00]. Outside, a door opens.
Mien doesn't turn to look at them. She only looks at me.
ending_segfault_1.glitchText: [TIME'S UP]: POWER IS ABOUT TO BE CUT.

ending_segfault_2.speaker: Memory
ending_segfault_2.text:
The screen goes dark. The room fades corner by corner, only rain on the tin roof.
Then the rain is gone too. The last thing I hear is my name, half-called: 'An... uh...'

end_game_neutral.speaker: Epilogue
end_game_neutral.text:
[NEUTRAL ENDING: SEVERED MEMORY]
No goodbye. A black screen, one blinking cursor... then nothing.

ch3_mien_early.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_early.text: {m:flinch}'Don't look at me like that...' {m:pleading,lean}'Lie down and rest, stop digging...'
ch3_mien_early.glitchText: THERE'S STILL A LOT IN THIS ROOM YOU HAVEN'T DARED TO FACE.

ch3_mien_need_bag.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_need_bag.text: {m:crying}'You still don't remember what was in your backpack that night?...' {m:pleading,lean}'No... forget it. Please.'
ch3_mien_need_bag.glitchText: WHAT WERE YOU CARRYING THAT NIGHT?

ch3_mien_bleed_stay.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_bleed_stay.text:
'At the river you said you weren't going anywhere. {m:melancholy}I believed you.'
{m:pleading,lean}'Now you want to open that door.'
ch3_mien_bleed_stay.glitchText: YOU SAID YOU WEREN'T GOING ANYWHERE.

choices.text: "I want to know what happened that night."
"I'm in a coma, right? I'll wake up."

ch3_mien_bleed_confront.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_bleed_confront.text: {m:laugh}'You said I was fooling us both. {m:sigh}Fine. The river's broken now.' {m:crying}'What else do you want to know?'
ch3_mien_bleed_confront.glitchText: YOU'RE THE ONE WHO SHATTERED OUR SUNSET.

choices.text: "I want to know what happened that night."
"I'm in a coma, right? I'll wake up."

ch3_mien_bleed_default.speaker: Mien
ch3_mien_bleed_default.text: {a:scared,flinch}Ambulance lights sweep the wall, then vanish. Mien is waiting for me to speak.

choices.text: "I want to know what happened that night."
"I'm in a coma, right? I'll wake up."

ending_shutdown_stay.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ending_shutdown_stay.text: {m:melancholy}'In the Sunset you stayed for me, knowing it was fake. {m:gentle,nod}{a:faint_smile}This time it's my turn to let go.'

ending_shutdown_confront.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_shutdown_confront.text: 'In the Sunset you said there was no rainy night there. {a:determined}{m:melancholy}But I want you to go on living, Mien. Really living, out there.'

obj_phone_mom.speaker: Message • Mom
obj_phone_mom.text: [21:47] Mom: "Coming home Saturday? I've pickled eggplant for you. If it rains when you go out, wear your raincoat."

choices.text: Type: "Got it, I'll be home Saturday." Send it tomorrow.

ch4_reflect.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ch4_reflect.text:
{a:sad,sink}Deadlines by day, AURA until three or four every night. Telling Mom "next week". Telling Mien "once this is done".
{a:sad,sigh}I promised myself three days of sleep after AURA. That sleep has lasted six months.

ch4_log_mom.speaker: Unsent Message: To Mom
ch4_log_mom.text:
> [DRAFT • 03:16 • 16/05 • TO: MOM]
> 'Got it, Mom. I'll be home Saturday, save me a jar of pickled eggplant.'
> [NOT SENT]
{a:sad,sink}Some words have to be carried by the living.

ending_stranger_1.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_stranger_1.text:
{a:sad,sink}Mien can't let go, because someone in this machine still remembers her. For her to live, that someone has to forget.
{a:determined,step}{m:surprised,tremble}> PURGE SECTOR_MIEN --all
> 1,204 photos... 38 voice clips... 1 music-box song...
> SUCCESS [100%]

ending_stranger_2.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ending_stranger_2.text:
{m:crying,sob}'An... I'm sorry... I couldn't hold on to you...'
{a:glitched,glitch}The screen flashes white once.

ending_stranger_3.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ending_stranger_3.text:
There's a strange girl crying on the screen.
{a:faint_smile,nod}'Hello... who are you?'
{m:surprised}{a:doubt,tilt}'I think I'm waiting for someone... but I can't remember their name.'

end_game_stranger.speaker: Epilogue
end_game_stranger.text:
[SECRET ENDING: THE STRANGER]
The man she loves just died a second time, right in front of her, and still smiles politely at her like a stranger.
Mien stands, and pulls the breaker herself.
The screen goes dark.

end_game_abandoned.speaker: System
end_game_abandoned.text:
> You left at {LEFT_AT}.
> An waited until exactly 03:30:00.
> No one stayed with him.

obj_hall_mirror.speaker: Convex Mirror
obj_hall_mirror.text: A yellowed convex mirror. Big head, short legs. {a:faint_smile,laugh}At least I look well-fed in here.

obj_hall_clock.speaker: Hallway Clock
obj_hall_clock.text: 03:14. The second hand ticks forward, then snaps back. {a:exhausted,sigh}Dead battery.

obj_bath_sink.speaker: Tap
obj_bath_sink.text: Ice-cold, rusty water. {a:faint_smile,nod}Wide awake. {a:doubt,tilt}Don't want to see my face right now anyway.

obj_bath_sink_more.speaker: Monologue
obj_bath_sink_more.text: {a:doubt,tilt}Someone's typing through the wall. {a:exhausted,sigh}I turn off the tap. The typing stops too.

obj_bath_toilet.speaker: Bathroom
obj_bath_toilet.text: The bulb burnt out last week. The bucket's nearly empty. {a:exhausted,sigh}Need to fill it early tomorrow.

obj_bath_toilet_fill.speaker: Monologue
obj_bath_toilet_fill.text: Weak power, the tap only drips. {a:faint_smile,laugh}I give up at forty.

node_sleep_ready.speaker: Monologue
node_sleep_ready.text: {a:exhausted,sigh}Album's open, and I remembered 17/05. My eyelids are heavy.

choices.text: Take a pill and go to sleep.

obj_corkboard.speaker: Corkboard
obj_corkboard.text:
The handover date circled in red, Mien's notes, a spare key. In the corner: a speeding fine, Tran Hoang An, March.
{a:faint_smile,laugh}Mien sulked for a week after that.

ch4_reconstruct.speaker: An (Memory Copy #314)
ch4_reconstruct.text:
An old AURA form, every line blank.
{a:doubt}I can't remember that night. I can only piece it together from what's left in the machine.

ch4_confession.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_confession.text:
'You took the pill at half ten, nodding off on the stairs... and still insisted on going, to make it by midnight.'
'I yanked the bike key with the chipped-ear cat charm off your keyring. I lied that I could handle it.'

ch4_deflect.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_deflect.text:
{m:gentle}Mien sighs with relief.
'You were exhausted and dozed off on the bike, that's all. Slippery road. Nobody's fault.'
She smiles. Too fast.

ending_corrupt_3_truth.speaker: System
ending_corrupt_3_truth.text:
Out there, the breaker drops at 03:30. In here, those two minutes never end.
The bench at An Yen. The sun stands still. The music box loops back at the eighth bar.
Every few minutes, Mien asks: 'Are you cold?'
Now you know which night she's asking about. You still answer: 'No.'

ending_stranger_3b.speaker: System
ending_stranger_3b.text:
The question she carried out of that rainy night has no one left to answer it.
The only person who could forgive her has just forgotten her name.

ch4_confession_2.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_confession_2.text: '...That night, I was the one driving.'

ch4_confession_3.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_confession_3.text:
'The wheel slid out on the overpass bend. You twisted round and wrapped yourself over me... then a very dry sound, your back against the steel rail.'
'I only got scratches. You died shielding me.'

ch2_meet_cold.speaker: Mien
ch2_meet_cold.text:
{m:gentle}'It's windy. Are you cold?'
{a:faint_smile}'No.'
Mien lets out a small breath. Then smiles.

choices.text: "It's beautiful. Can we stay here forever?"
"Why does this place feel... kind of fake?"

ch4_confession_4.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_confession_4.text:
'I asked if you were cold.'
'I kept asking, for twenty minutes.'
'...You never answered me.'

ch4_confession_5.speaker: Mien (Real World)
ch4_confession_5.text:
'The police know. Your mom knows, and never said a word of blame. When I loaded you in, I erased one line on the chart; the original I only dared lock away.'
'In here, every time I asked, you answered. But you never knew what I was asking.'
